facts.anchor: She played four games of mini golf in a row that second afternoon at the Turbo Putt, spending a little longer at the window after each game making small talk with JulesPublicAccessAfterworld, standing outside that infamous wooden shed she knew so well from Jules’s videos.

facts.fact: Bethany 告诉自己来 Lubbock 是为了 closure：一个月前那个晚上，她在 GlobalVill 队列目睹 Jules 的自杀未遂并报警叫警察干预；她只想从安全距离确认 Jules Estrada 还活着、还在呼吸。
facts.anchor: she told herself it was for closure, just to check from a safe distance and make sure Jules Estrada was still alive, still breathing after that night a month earlier when Bethany witnessed their suicide attempt in the GlobalVill queue and called the cops to intervene.

facts.fact: 此后一个月 Bethany 自驾车跑遍美国左半边（Denver、Oklahoma City、Oakland），自称在物色重新开始生活的新城镇，一直回避 Abel 发来的担心短信、没想好逃脱计划就不回复。
facts.anchor: Denver, Oklahoma City, Oakland. She told herself she was shopping for a new town to start fresh in, avoiding Abel’s worried texts until she had a clear plan of escape figured out.

facts.fact: Bethany 对 Jules 谎称自己是来 Lubbock 探望退休定居的父母（父亲第二次心脏病发作、她从 Austin 的工作请假来照顾）；她爸爸确实已经两次心脏病，但Bethany 策略性删去了他其实远在数百英里外 Harlingen 的事实。
facts.anchor: Her dad really was two heart attacks deep, but Bethany strategically edited out the part where he was actually hundreds of miles away, back in Harlingen.

facts.fact: Bethany 说没料到在这里会碰到像 Jules 这样的人、这地方对 trans girl 不会好过，Jules 回应自己不是 trans，只是化化妆、穿 goth 行头。
facts.anchor: “Oh,” Jules said. “I’m not trans. I just wear makeup and goth shit.”

facts.fact: Jules 邀 Bethany 当晚一起吃饭，说想吃他最喜欢的馆子、他请客——公路正对面的烤牛肉店 Arby’s；Bethany 答应说想继续和 Jules 聊。
facts.anchor: “Awesome,” Jules said. “I want to keep talking to you, too. It’s this roast beef place called Arby’s, right across the highway. You’re going to love it.”

facts.fact: 被 GlobalVill 复雇：HR 说 manager Douglas 其实无权解雇她、她技术上仍有这份工作；次日公司把她的工作笔记本快递寄来、把她的薪水翻倍，并让她签了大约十份 NDA，确保她永远不对媒体开口。
facts.anchor: The next day, they express mailed her company laptop, doubled her pay, and had her sign like ten NDAs to make sure she wouldn’t talk to the press, now or ever.

facts.fact: 电话里 Kyle 讲述夜班看到的一段视频游戏录像：多名玩家在游戏里 gang rape 一个顶多十一二岁的女孩头像，他说最糟的是自己只能按下 green-button——不违反站规、不算真的强奸；视频仍在站上、播放量破百万且还在涨，评论全是 “this is hilarious!” 和 “yeah, rape that bitch.”，Kyle 说这让他想死。
facts.anchor: The worst part was I had to green-button it. It wasn’t actually against any site rules. It was just a video game, so it wasn’t really rape. It’s still on the site. A million views and counting. The comments are all ‘this is hilarious!’ and ‘yeah, rape that bitch.’ It makes me want to die.
